skills.name: Fireball
skills.text: Hurl a fireball that explodes and sets foes ablaze.

skills.name: Frost Nova
skills.text: Blast ice around you, chilling everything nearby. Chill twice to freeze.

skills.name: Chain Lightning
skills.text: Lightning arcs between up to 5 foes, shocking them.

skills.name: Boulder Toss
skills.text: Roll a boulder that crushes through every foe in its path.

skills.name: Shadow Step
skills.text: Step through shadow to a foe, striking and hexing it. Briefly untouchable.

skills.name: Steam Burst
skills.text: Scalding steam burns everything around you and blinds it: blinded foes miss half their attacks.

skills.name: Plasma Orb
skills.text: A slow orb that zaps nearby foes, then detonates in flame.

skills.name: Magma Eruption
skills.text: The ground erupts under your target, leaving a lava pool that keeps burning.

skills.name: Hellfire Brand
skills.text: Brand a group of foes. Branded foes explode on death and brand everything nearby.

skills.name: Blizzard
skills.text: A storm of ice and lightning that chills and shocks: a Superconduct engine.

skills.name: Glacial Spikes
skills.text: A line of ice spikes erupts toward your target, freezing everything it pierces.

skills.name: Soul Freeze
skills.text: Freeze and hex a group of foes. Frozen foes under 25% life shatter instantly.

skills.name: Magnet Quake
skills.text: Drag every foe nearby into one spot, then slam them, shocked and staggered.

skills.name: Void Bolt
skills.text: A bolt that yanks you to whatever it hits, then arcs to 3 more foes.

skills.name: Grave Golem
skills.text: Raise a golem of stone and shadow that draws foes to it and pummels them.

reactions.name: Melt
reactions.text: Fire hits a chilled or frozen foe for double damage.

reactions.name: Shatter
reactions.text: Earth hits a frozen foe for massive bonus damage.

reactions.name: Overload
reactions.text: Storm hits a burning foe and it explodes, hitting everything nearby.

reactions.name: Superconduct
reactions.text: Frost hits a shocked foe and freezes it solid.

reactions.name: Soulfire
reactions.text: Fire hits a hexed foe and part of the damage heals you.

masteries.name: Inferno
masteries.text: Burning foes spread their flames when they die.

masteries.name: Permafrost
masteries.text: Freezes last 50% longer, and frozen foes take 30% more damage.

masteries.name: Tempest
masteries.text: Every chain jumps to 2 more foes, and shock's damage bonus doubles.

masteries.name: Night's Embrace
masteries.text: Killing a hexed foe heals you for 4% of your max life.
